content.description: This table presents the relationships of reviewers with industry and other entities at the time of peer review and publication for specific clinical guidelines. The reviewers hold positions in various universities, medical centers, and councils. The table highlights their roles, affiliations, and any consultancies, speaker bureaus, partnerships, research, or financial benefits they might have. Companies such as AstraZeneca, Sanofi-aventis, and Abbott are mentioned in connection with the reviewers.
content.purpose: Disclosure of potential conflicts of interest for transparency in clinical guideline development.
